ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { aplicacion: payload.aplicacion, canal: payload.tipo_canal, codigo: vars.otpCode }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dw::Crypto var str = payload.aplicacion ++ "-" ++ payload.valor_canal ++ "-" ++ payload.identificacion_cliente ++ "-" ++ vars.otpCode --- dw::Crypto::MD5(str as Binary)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var fields = if (vars.inputPayload.tipo_canal == "EMAIL") p('oracle-sapi.sendMessage.fieldsEmail') else p('oracle-sapi.sendMessage.fieldsSms') --- { "tipo_canal": vars.inputPayload.tipo_canal, "addId": p('oracle-sapi.sendMessage.addId'), "triggerId": if (vars.inputPayload.tipo_canal == "EMAIL") p('oracle-sapi.sendMessage.triggerEmail') else p('oracle-sapi.sendMessage.triggerSms'), "fields": fields splitBy "|", "records": [vars.inputPayload.nombre_cliente, vars.otpCode, vars.inputPayload.valor_canal] }
